data.title: Kevin O'Leary Is Certain Ethereum Won't Be the 'Standard' Across Industry Sectors — The 'Shark' Says Thes
data.description: Influential investor and media personality Kevin O’Leary expressed doubts on Sunday, September 20, about Ethereum's dominance in the cryptocurrency space, hinting at potential investments in chains like Solana and Avalanche.
data.author: Aniket Verma
